title: TRUNK-6686: Restore relevance weighting in patient search lost in the Hibernate Search 6 migration
body:
## Description

Restores query-time relevance boosting for patient/person searches to match the ranking behavior from `OpenMRS 2.6.x`. This ensures more relevant name matches are ranked appropriately after the Hibernate Search 6 migration.

### Changes

- Added query-time boosts for `personName` fields:
    - `givenName` / `familyName`: exact 8x, prefix 4x, anywhere 2x
    - `middleName` / `familyName2`: exact 4x, prefix 2x, anywhere 1x
- Added equivalent boosts for `personAttribute` searches.
- Added a regression test verifying that a `givenName` match is ranked above a `middleName` match.
- Updated existing tests to avoid relying on ordering between equally ranked results.
- Preserved and strengthened exact-match-first regression coverage.
